verseText: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us...
meaning: God is able to do way more than we could ever even think about asking for. His power is beyond our wildest imaginations!

recall.question: Immeasurably means “too much to measure.” How much does this verse say God is able to do?

meaning.question: What should we remember when something seems impossible?

application.prompt: Have you ever faced a problem that seemed too big to solve? Remember, God's power is greater than anything you can imagine! You can bring even your biggest worries and hopes to Him in prayer, trusting Him with whatever happens.
